description:
PR group C1: one core PR shared with site-split-10, with separate commits, so the batch needs one oracle review instead of two. It needs oracle review because it changes `.github/soundness-paths.txt`.

1. Write `docs/development/adr/adr-site-repo-split.md`:
   - Motivation: the Astro cutover was delayed by coupling to core CI, so the site needs isolated CI and fast rollouts.
   - Decisions D1-D20 from the plan.
   - The language rule: no Python source in the site repo, no JS/TS source in core; run-time third-party tools are allowed.
   - Supersessions:
     - `single-repo-migration.md`, in part;
     - `adr-astro-unified-site.md` D12, D13 and D14, where they conflict;
     - `adr-independent-publication-authorities.md`.
   - The "Consumers" appendix.
   Satisfy `scripts/check_decision_records.py`.
2. In `.github/soundness-paths.txt`:
   - Replace `prefix .github/workflows/` with a `regex` that excludes only `docs.yml`, `publication-*.yml` and `rehearse-release-isolation.yml`.
   - Remove the `file` lines for those workflows and for the missing `publication-lane-docs.yml` and `publication-lane-explorer.yml`.
   - Replace `prefix publication/` and `prefix scripts/publication/` with `file` entries for the corpus files that survive the publication retirement. Derive the list from the imports of the corpus workflows and `scripts/publication/verify_corpus_promotion.py`.
   - Keep `scripts/site_deploy/`, `deploy/`, `site-deploy.yml` and the site-inventory entries. Core deploys production until the cutover.
3. In `tests/unit/scripts/test_soundness_paths.py`:
   - Drop the expectations for the excluded and missing workflows.
   - Assert that the regex still matches `ci.yml`, `trunk.yml`, `oracle-review.yml`, `release.yml`, `site-deploy.yml`, `validate-submission.yml` and a made-up `new-example.yml`.
   - Assert that it matches none of the excluded files.
